warranty.title: Warranty Policy
warranty.intro: Every Furnivo piece is built to last a lifetime and backed by our structural guarantee.

sections.b: Furnivo furniture carries a 5-year warranty against manufacturing defects in structure, frame, and joinery. Lighting carries a 2-year warranty on electrical components. Coverage applies to the original purchaser with proof of purchase.

Natural variation in wood, leather, marble, and other organic materials; normal wear; damage from misuse, improper cleaning, or exposure to extreme humidity, heat, or direct sunlight; and any alterations made after delivery.

Bespoke pieces carry the same structural warranty. Because dimensions, materials, and finishes are chosen by you, cosmetic preferences are confirmed at production sign-off and are not covered thereafter.
Contact hello@furnivo.com with your order number and photographs. Approved claims are repaired, or replaced where repair is not possible, at no cost within the warranty term.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using furnivo.com you agree to the terms below. Please read them carefully.

sections.b: This website and its content are provided for personal, non-commercial use. You may not reproduce, resell, or exploit any part of the site without written consent from Furnivo.

All prices are in US Dollars (USD) and inclusive of VAT unless stated otherwise. We reserve the right to correct pricing errors and to decline or cancel orders. Made-to-order pieces are confirmed by written quotation before production.
All trademarks, imagery, designs, and text remain the property of Furnivo or its partner brands. Product photography is used with permission of the respective brands.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Furnivo is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of the site. Nothing in these terms limits your statutory rights under UK consumer law.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We collect only what we need to serve you well, and we never sell your data.

sections.b: Contact and delivery details you provide, order history, and standard analytics such as pages viewed and device type. Payment details are processed securely by our payment partners and are never stored by Furnivo.
To process orders and enquiries, arrange delivery and installation, provide after-sales care, and — only with your consent — send you occasional news about new collections.
We share data only with logistics, payment, and communication partners necessary to fulfil your order, under strict confidentiality. We do not sell personal data to third parties.
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time by emailing privacy@furnivo.com. You can unsubscribe from marketing at any point.

consumer.title: Consumer Rights
consumer.intro: Your rights as a customer under the UK Consumer Rights Act, and how we honour them.

sections.b: You have the right to clear, accurate information about every piece — materials, dimensions, origin, lead time, and total price inclusive of VAT — before you commit to purchase.
If a piece arrives faulty or not as described, you are entitled to repair, replacement, or a full refund. Report issues within 7 days of delivery with photographs.
In-stock orders may be cancelled before dispatch for a full refund. Made-to-order pieces may be cancelled within 48 hours of order confirmation, before materials are committed.
You will always be dealt with honestly and respectfully. Complaints are acknowledged within one business day and resolved as quickly as possible.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.intro: White-glove delivery and installation across the UK, handled by our own trained team.

sections.b: In-stock pieces are delivered within 1–2 weeks. Made-to-order furniture takes 6–12 weeks depending on materials and finish; your confirmed timeline is stated on your quotation.
Every delivery includes room-of-choice placement, full assembly and installation, and removal of all packaging. Our team treats your home with the same care as our workshop.
We deliver across mainland UK. Delivery and installation are included on orders above $5,000; a flat fee applies below that and is shown at checkout.
Once your order is ready, our concierge contacts you to arrange a delivery window that suits you, including evenings and weekends where possible.

returns.title: Return & Refund
returns.intro: We want you to love every piece. If something is not right, here is how returns work.

sections.b: In-stock, as-shown furniture and lighting may be returned within 14 days of delivery, provided items are unused and in original condition. Collection is arranged by our team.
Because bespoke pieces are built to your exact specification, they are non-returnable unless faulty or not as specified. We confirm every detail with you before production begins.
Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method within 7–10 business days of collection and inspection. Delivery fees on non-faulty returns are non-refundable.
Begin a return from Order history in your account, or contact hello@furnivo.com with your order number. Our concierge handles the rest.

FAQS.a: Yes. All prices shown are in US Dollars and inclusive of 5% VAT unless explicitly stated otherwise.

FAQS.q: What is the difference between in-stock and made-to-order?
FAQS.a: In-stock pieces are available as shown with a fixed price, cart, and checkout. Made-to-order pieces are built to your chosen dimensions, materials, and finish — you submit your requirements and we prepare a quotation before production.

FAQS.q: How long does a custom piece take?
FAQS.a: Made-to-order furniture typically takes 6–12 weeks depending on materials and finish. Your exact timeline is confirmed on your quotation before you commit.

FAQS.q: Do you deliver across the UK?
FAQS.a: Yes — we deliver and install across mainland UK with our own white-glove team, including room placement, assembly, and packaging removal.

FAQS.q: Can I see pieces before buying?
FAQS.a: Absolutely. Visit our Marylebone showroom, or book a private appointment with a design consultant through the Contact page.

FAQS.q: What payment methods do you accept?
FAQS.a: Credit and debit cards, Tabby and Tamara (buy-now-pay-later), Apple Pay, bank transfer, and cash on delivery.

FAQS.q: Can I return a custom piece?
FAQS.a: Made-to-order pieces are non-returnable unless faulty or not as specified, since they are built to your exact requirements. As-shown pieces can be returned within 14 days.

FAQS.q: Do you offer trade or project pricing?
FAQS.a: Yes — we work with interior designers and hospitality projects. Contact our team to discuss trade terms and volume commissions.
